strategy_roster.name: Delta RSI
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish 7/28 RSI cross above a slow RSI over 50 approximates the documented Up transition, with the inverse or loss of trend as exit. Periods and Level are not supplied, so 7/28/50 are explicit fallbacks.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger EMA Stats
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 20-period, 2-standard-deviation lower band is entered and EMA(20) is the exit target. The wider 3-standard-deviation band is a stateful entry-relative stop and therefore cannot be represented by stop_loss_pct.

strategy_roster.name: iCCI iMA
strategy_roster.notes: ROC and its EMA are used as momentum and signal proxies because CCI is unavailable; the 20-bar momentum losing zero approximates the secondary CCI reversal. Periods and pips are unspecified, so 14/9/20 and null percent protection are explicit fallbacks.

strategy_roster.name: Polish Layer Expert Advisor System Efficient
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma(close,9) > sma(close,45) and crossabove(rsi(close,7),rsi(close,14)) and roc(close,14) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: The 9/45 price trend is retained while a bullish 7/14 RSI cross and positive ROC substitute for Stochastic, DeMarker, and Williams confirmations. Exact triple crossings are unavailable; 7777/17-pip protection is not converted to percentages.

strategy_roster.name: EMA Crossover with Volume + Stacked TP & Trailing SL
strategy_roster.notes: The EMA(21/55) crossover is filtered by volume at 1.2 times its 20-bar average, exactly following the documented entry. ATR(14) stacked targets and trailing management are stateful and cannot be expressed as percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Breakdown Level Intraday
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar prior channel approximates the previous-day high for the long breakout, with the low channel as exit. The six-point delta, order time, break-even, trailing, and 120/90-point protections are unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Williams R
strategy_roster.notes: The lower Bollinger condition and RSI(14)<30 approximate the documented Williams %R<-80 confirmation, with return to the middle band as exit. The 2*ATR stop is not a percentage field.

strategy_roster.name: Adaptive RSI
strategy_roster.notes: A turn in the one-bar change of RSI(14) is a direct proxy for the unsupported adaptive RSI turning up or down. The documented opposite-signal exit is retained; no stops are specified.

strategy_roster.name: Close Profit End Of Week
strategy_roster.notes: This is an exit-only Friday profit utility with no entry signal; the impossible guards deliberately prevent fabricated trades. Calendar time, floating-profit state, and the 20:00 cutoff cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: Trade Entry Detector, Wick to Body Ratio
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < bb_lower(close,20,2) and close > open and close - low >= 2 * (close - open)
strategy_roster.notes: A lower-band close with a lower wick at least twice the bullish body implements the documented long wick-to-body condition. Bollinger 20/2 and the two-wick ratio are fallbacks because no parameter values are supplied; the opposite band exits.
